nodes.name: settings.gradle
nodes.summary: Generated Gradle settings file that names the Android project root for the Tauri-generated Android build.

nodes.name: Contents.json
nodes.summary: Xcode asset catalog manifest enumerating the app icon image variants (sizes and scales) for the iOS/macOS app icon set.

nodes.name: Contents.json
nodes.summary: Root Xcode asset catalog manifest carrying only the catalog info/author metadata.

nodes.name: ExportOptions.plist
nodes.summary: Xcode export options property list controlling how the iOS build is packaged and signed for distribution.

nodes.name: Podfile
nodes.summary: CocoaPods dependency manifest declaring the floppy_iOS and floppy_macOS targets and a post-install hook that strips per-pod deployment targets so they inherit from the Podfile.
nodes.languageNotes: Ruby DSL; post_install hook mutates each pod target's build settings.

nodes.name: bindings.h
nodes.summary: Generated C header exposing the Rust entry point so the Objective-C++ launcher can call into the Tauri core.
nodes.languageNotes: C header bridging Swift/Objective-C++ to the Rust static library.

nodes.name: main.mm
nodes.summary: Objective-C++ iOS launcher that invokes the Rust-generated entry point to start the Tauri application on Apple platforms.
nodes.languageNotes: Objective-C++ (.mm) shim calling the C binding into Rust.

nodes.name: Info.plist
nodes.summary: iOS application property list declaring bundle identity, launch configuration, orientations, and permission usage strings for the floppy_iOS target.

nodes.name: floppy_iOS.entitlements
nodes.summary: iOS entitlements property list granting the app's platform capabilities (sandbox/network) for the floppy_iOS target.

nodes.name: project.yml
nodes.summary: XcodeGen project definition describing the floppy iOS/macOS targets, build configs, setting groups, and file groups used to regenerate the Xcode project.
nodes.languageNotes: XcodeGen spec: targetTemplates and settingGroups deduplicate shared build settings across targets.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Desktop binary entry point that delegates to the floppy_lib::run library crate to boot the Tauri application.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin binary crate; all app logic lives in the sibling library crate floppy_lib.

nodes.name: app.html
nodes.summary: SvelteKit HTML document shell with viewport-fit=cover so the webview extends under the notch, and the mount points for the app head and body.

nodes.name: edge-swipe.svelte.ts
nodes.summary: Svelte action that detects a left-edge horizontal swipe gesture and invokes an onOpen callback, used to open the mobile navigation drawer.

nodes.name: edgeSwipe
nodes.summary: Registers window touch listeners that track a horizontal drag beginning at the screen's left edge and fire onOpen once the swipe passes a threshold; returns a destroy cleanup.

nodes.name: code.ts
nodes.summary: Code-phrase utilities defining the canonical code pattern plus helpers to validate a complete code and sanitize raw keystroke input into the allowed character set.

nodes.name: isCompleteCode
nodes.summary: Returns whether a trimmed value matches the full canonical code pattern, used to gate submission.

nodes.name: sanitizeCodeInput
nodes.summary: Lowercases raw input and collapses disallowed characters and repeated separators so only valid code characters can be typed.

nodes.name: CodeInput.svelte
nodes.summary: Canonical code-phrase input component that filters keystrokes via sanitizeCodeInput and only submits on Enter when the value is a complete code, with a clear button.

nodes.name: ActivityView.svelte
nodes.summary: Transfer history timeline that loads activity on mount, groups entries by day, and renders each transfer as a rail node coloured by direction and outcome.

nodes.name: activity.ts
nodes.summary: Activity data layer defining the ActivityEntry model, a sample data generator, and helpers to load, group by day, and format timestamps for the transfer timeline.

nodes.name: loadActivity
nodes.summary: Asynchronously returns the most recent activity entries, capped by an optional limit, from the sample data source.

nodes.name: sampleActivity
nodes.summary: Builds a fixed set of synthetic transfer entries with varied directions, statuses, and timestamps to populate the activity timeline while real history is unavailable.

nodes.name: groupByDay
nodes.summary: Sorts activity entries newest-first and buckets them into day groups labelled with a human-friendly heading.

nodes.name: dayLabel
nodes.summary: Produces a relative day heading (Today/Yesterday or a localized date, dropping the year when it is the current year) for a timestamp.

nodes.name: formatTime
nodes.summary: Formats a timestamp as a localized time-of-day string for display next to a timeline entry.

nodes.name: LoginView.svelte
nodes.summary: Preview-only sign-in form stub with disabled email/password and Google buttons, shown while real accounts are not yet implemented.

nodes.name: border-beam.svelte
nodes.summary: Decorative animated border-beam effect that runs a gradient sprite along an element's rounded border using motion offset-path animation.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines CSS custom properties with motion-sv offset-path animation for the traveling beam.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the BorderBeam component as the public entry point of the border-beam directory.

nodes.name: IncomingOfferDialog.svelte
nodes.summary: Responsive accept/decline dialog driven by pairing.incoming that prompts the user when a peer offers files, treating any non-accept dismissal as declining.

nodes.name: IncomingPairDialog.svelte
nodes.summary: Responsive dialog driven by pairing.request for confirming and naming a device that finished the pairing handshake, showing the SAS to compare on code-based pairings.

nodes.name: SettingsView.svelte
nodes.summary: Settings panel with a working theme segmented control (via mode-watcher) alongside local-only stubs for download folder, notifications, per-code folders, and custom relay.

nodes.name: AppHeader.svelte
nodes.summary: Cross-platform application header rendering a status-bar-safe mobile app bar or a desktop titlebar with per-platform chrome (macOS traffic-light spacer, Windows min/max/close) plus the sidebar toggle.

nodes.name: AppSidebar.svelte
nodes.summary: The app's single navigation surface: a collapsible desktop sidebar / mobile drawer sourcing destinations from nav-items, with a device badge and a placeholder sign-in dialog.
